description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudio SetCaps task, which configures GStreamer caps for a WebAudio player component. It uses Google Test framework to verify correct behavior of setting caps based on WebAudio configuration, including handling of different PCM formats and edge cases.

classes.name: WebAudioSetCapsTest
classes.description: Unit test fixture for testing the SetCaps task in WebAudio player, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: getPcmFormat
methods.description: Constructs a string representing the PCM format based on configuration flags (float, signed, sample size, endianness).

methods.name: expectBuildPcmCaps
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating GStreamer caps with specific PCM parameters.

methods.name: expectGetCapsStr
methods.description: Sets expectations for converting GstCaps to string and freeing the string.

methods.name: expectSetCaps
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving and setting caps on the app source element.

methods.name: expectUnref
methods.description: Sets expectations for unreferencing GstCaps objects.

methods.name: expectSetBytesPerSamplePcm
methods.description: Verifies that the bytes per sample calculation matches expected value based on PCM configuration.
